# netactuate_nke_autoscaler_addon (Resource)

Manages the netactuate-cluster-autoscaler NKE addon.

Install this addon once per cluster. Enable autoscaling separately on each managed node pool. Catalog availability and Kubernetes version requirements are checked at plan time. Unset configuration fields use the catalog defaults.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_nke_autoscaler_addon" "example" {
  cluster_id = 12345
  config {
    scale_down_enabled               = true
    scale_down_unneeded_time         = "10m"
    scale_down_delay_after_add       = "10m"
    scale_down_utilization_threshold = 0.5
    max_node_provision_time          = "15m"
    expander                        = "least-waste"
    skip_nodes_with_local_storage    = true
    balance_similar_node_groups      = false
    max_nodes_total                  = 20
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (Number) Cluster ID. Changing this creates a new resource.

### Optional

- `version` (String) Addon version. Defaults to the catalog selection.
- `config` (Block List, Max: 1) Typed autoscaler configuration:
  - `scale_down_enabled` (Boolean) Allow scale down.
  - `scale_down_unneeded_time` (String) Duration from 1m to 24h.
  - `scale_down_delay_after_add` (String) Duration from 1m to 24h.
  - `scale_down_utilization_threshold` (Number) Utilization from 0.1 to 0.9.
  - `max_node_provision_time` (String) Duration from 5m to 60m.
  - `expander` (String) `least-waste` or `priority`.
  - `skip_nodes_with_local_storage` (Boolean) Avoid removing workers with local storage.
  - `balance_similar_node_groups` (Boolean) Balance similar pools.
  - `max_nodes_total` (Number) Total node limit, 1 to 1000. Omit for the catalog default.

Durations use an integer followed by `s`, `m` or `h`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Cluster ID.

## Import

Import is supported using `clusterId`:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_nke_autoscaler_addon.example 12345
```
